newsitem.title: USA: Sage Energy to redeem outstanding debentures.
newsitem.headline: Sage Energy to redeem outstanding debentures.

text.p: Sage Energy Co said Monday it intends to redeem its remaining outstanding 8 1/2 percent convertible subordinated debentures.
The redemption is to be carried out at a price equal to 100 percent of the principal amount of each debenture redeemed.
The redemption is expected to be completed during the quarter ending June 30, it said.
Sage Energy said that as a result of the redemption, itwill request the American Stock Exchange to delist the debentures.
The company, based in San Antonio, Texas, is engaged in the exploration, development, production and sale of oil and natural gas.
